items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: He thought very highly of Don for that, you know.

ctx.x: section. He just left him on his own, and he could lead the section any way he wanted to. And I thought that was a compliment in itself. He didn't have to tell him what he wanted. He thought very highly of Don for that, you know.
Cole was a nice person, but things happen in a band, you know... Well, things happen anywhere. And things just don't always go down just the way that they should go.
